consequence.statement: New CLI capability only: `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` commands become available in the flux CLI; the evidence states no change to existing behavior and no operational consequence for an operator who does nothing.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 implements new `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` CLI commands (reconcile, suspend and resume for image policy).

decision.reason: [ev-7eb7fed1368f] only says that new `flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy` CLI commands were added, which is a purely additive capability. Nothing in it says that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or must be migrated. So an environment that does nothing has no operational consequence, and "none" (informational) fits.
